decision: Extend the cohesive JobCardExtras presentation module after rollback; do not introduce a configurable full-card shell or merge either window/hook.

must_remain_window_specific.actions: AI open mutates opened state and has interested/save actions; Board uses an external anchor and treats opened as saved.
must_remain_window_specific.board: tag preview, sorting and tab layout belong only to JobBoardTabbedWindow.
must_remain_window_specific.matching: score, fit, skill expansion and reason belong only to AIJobMatchWindow.
must_remain_window_specific.title: AI supports manual translation and score layout; Board title is an external link with background title_en.

purpose: Bound the post-rollback frontend card extraction with verified behavior.

safe_shared_presentation.contract: remote/source/employment labels only; caller keeps layout and source color
